description:
"Curse an enemy with a destructive rune, dealing |cffffff11020|r Magic Damage to the target and all other nearby enemies after |cffffff3.5|r seconds.

The curse will continue to haunt the enemy and explode a second time, dealing |cffffff11020|r Magic Damage to the target and all other nearby enemies after an additional |cffffff8.5|r seconds.

You can have only one Haunting Curse active at a time."
